scope: Actual local headless Chrome, native click/key flows, bounded injected failures, refactored lifecycle, and isolated theme patch

checks.name: initial full DOM, public hooks, computed styles and bounds
desktop same-state pixel capture
selection, Shift toggle and cross-frame shared state
hover/focus are shared without selecting or arming
native Move, relay preview, Confirm and local focus recovery
repeated disabled Confirm clicks cannot dispatch a second order
invalid friendly attack preserves prior order, then hostile target recovers
Stop repeats create separate orders, matching actual baseline semantics
empty selection repeated shortcuts fail without orders
Cancel clears error and keeps selected ships and committed records
Enter and Space retain native button action, scoped M/A/S/Escape
pointer map coordinates use bounds and fixture world dimensions
modifiers, repeat, and shortcuts outside a scene are ignored
all authored presets and repeated reset match
public hook clones cannot mutate live fixture/state
frame configuration stays presentational and matches
native flows and computed geometry at 390 CSS pixels
native flows and computed geometry at 320 CSS pixels
HTTP, network and invalid JSON loading fail before mounting, same as baseline
refactored dispose stops detached/global input and supports fresh remount
isolated requested theme patch changes only tokens and rendered accent; domain unchanged
normal-flow browser page errors absent

unrun: Malformed fixture schema recovery (baseline has none)
